loudness.quote: Executor starts running but with no node inside, and just hangs on waiting for work forever.

notes: E1 confirmed: issue #2414 gives exact reproduction steps (replace the new .so with the old one, run the generated main) and the observed hang. E2 stop_step 6 (library API): the generated node main is a host that loads the component library as a plugin; the failure depends on the class name the loaded library exports, which crosses the host/plugin boundary. The two failed conditions are both correct — element_removed_or_renamed (the class absent from the deployed older .so) and other (the host's missing not-found check, an internal defect of this composition that the reporter asked to fix). Loudness silent_documented/run is right: no diagnostic, empty executor. Resolution recommended is right: PR #2415 ("crash on no class found", merged rolling as 091f29fc) turns the hang into a refusal, but the reporter's Humble composition has no released fix and the PR's demonstration used a test executable, not the reporter's library.
